texte.Elle ne rédige aucune clause et ne lit a: It drafts no clause and reads no contract: it records what you declare. And the microenterprise derogation in the last subparagraph of paragraph # covers ONLY point e) — accepting it elsewhere, or for an entity that is not a microenterprise, would pass off an absence as an arrangement provided for by the text.
texte.Elle ne signale rien à votre place et n’: It reports nothing on your behalf and starts no countdown: it displays the deadlines and what must be submitted at each stage. Nor does it say whether your incident is “severe” within the meaning of the Regulation — that qualification is made on the facts, and it is binding.
texte.Elle ne traduit pas le cadre et ne s’y s: It does not translate the framework and does not replace it. Nor does it say which of the seven trustworthiness characteristics prevail: the document does not rank them, it has them traded off — making a system more explainable can make it less safe.
texte.Elle ne tranche pas en droit. La notion: It does not rule on the law. The notion of “substantial modification” is assessed in relation to the product’s cybersecurity, not the technical extent of the change: a minor patch that reopens an attack surface can be one, a redesign that does not touch it may not be. This page tells you where to look and what is at stake; it does not replace the analysis of the actual product.
texte.Elle nomme ce que le plan ne fermera pas: It names what the plan will not close, whatever you do. These points are known in advance: keeping quiet about them does not remove them, it means they are discovered in front of the auditor.
texte.Elle nomme le recrutement et la sélectio: It names recruitment and selection, placing targeted job advertisements, analysing and filtering applications, evaluating candidates — then allocating tasks based on behaviour and monitoring performance. An employment agency or a temporary work agency performs precisely these acts: it is the most directly affected sector of the thirteen.
texte.Elle n’accepte pas qu’un article de # à: It does not accept that a clause from # to # be declared “not applicable”: these are requirements, they cannot be excluded. Only Annex A controls can, and only with justification. A “not applicable” declaration placed on a clause is ignored, and the module says so rather than counting it.
texte.Elle n’annonce jamais une exposition max: It never announces a maximum exposure, because the Directive does not set one: your actual ceiling is found in the transposition law of each Member State where you operate, and it can go further. Above all, do not read these amounts as those of the CRA, which is a directly applicable Regulation: there, the amounts are the amounts. And it estimates no compliance cost.
It reflects the records, nothing else. A processing activity that has not been declared does not appear — and that is precisely the one that causes problems during an inspection.
texte.Elle refuse de travailler sans régime, e: It refuses to work without a regime, and that is deliberate: assessing an entity under the simplified framework against the twenty-six articles of Title II would make it pay for a programme half of which does not concern it. Nor does it deliver any compliance: DORA is an obligation, not a certifiable framework, and no body issues an attestation against it.
texte.Elle rend un taux pour chacune des neuf: It gives a rate for each of the nine standards, calculated from what you have already entered in the modules — nothing is reassessed here, everything is composed.
texte.Elle transforme les écarts mesurés en ac: It turns the measured gaps into ordered actions, each with what it actually earns on which standards.
texte.Elle viendra à son tour. L’ordre des éta: It will come in its turn. The order of the steps is
texte.Elle vit dans Parties prenantes, et ce m: It lives in Stakeholders, and this module deliberately does not duplicate it: two copies of a matrix diverge at the first decision.
texte.Elles viennent de rapprochements DÉCLARÉ: They come from DECLARED cross-references between frameworks — the Annex A # controls that serve Article #(#) of NIS #, the Annex A # controls that meet a Top # LLM risk. None is invented here: it is the only real benefit of keeping nine frameworks in the same place.

texte.En tant qu'importateur (Art. #), vous me: As an importer (Art. #), you place on the European market an AI system from a third country. Your obligations are verification obligations: you must ensure that the provider has drawn up the technical documentation and the conformity assessment. Hence the milestones register, classification, verification of the technical documentation, audit and attestation. The risk management system and the FRIA are the responsibility of the provider and the deployer respectively.
texte.En tant que distributeur (Art. #), vous: As a distributor (Art. #), you make an AI system available on the EU market without being its provider or importer. Your obligations are lighter: check that the marking and conformity are present. The milestones retained are therefore register, classification, compliance audit and attestation. Design, technical documentation and the FRIA are not your responsibility.
texte.En tant que fournisseur (Art. #), vous p: As a provider (Art. #), you carry all the obligations of the design cycle of a high-risk AI system. All seven milestones apply: register, classification, risk management system (Art. #), technical documentation (Art. #), fundamental rights impact assessment, compliance audit and final attestation (Art. #) preceding the CE marking.
